findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "tiktok-download-video" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_userPublishVideo, get_musicVideo, get_feedSearch, get_feedList, get_regionList, get_commentReply, get_commentList, get_challengePosts, get_mixPosts · Public sink: get_userPublishVideo, get_musicVideo, get_challengePosts, get_mixPosts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_userPublishVideo, get_musicVideo, get_feedSearch, get_feedList, get_regionList, get_commentReply, get_commentList, get_challengePosts, get_mixPosts · Public sink: get_userPublishVideo, get_musicVideo, get_challengePosts, get_mixPosts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
